language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon starts on the tabletop (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot closes its gripper around the spoon and lifts it clear of the table (frames 60–84, wrist_image and left_ego_image), then transports it to the open drawer (frames 95–135, image and wrist_image). It releases the spoon into the drawer at frames 137–143; the spoon is visibly resting inside at frames 144–148 in wrist_image. The empty gripper withdraws through frame 157. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
